# TheTravel

> > TheTravel is a comprehensive travel news and destination guide covering national parks, airline industry updates, travel safety regulations, and hidden gems across North America.

TheTravel provides timely coverage of travel advisories, airline route changes, TSA regulations, and national park developments. The site features destination guides highlighting small towns, natural wonders, and outdoor adventures, with particular focus on U.S. and Canadian travel experiences.

## Key Topics

- National Park Service
- TSA and airport security
- Air Canada route changes
- Travel safety advisories
- Small town destinations
- Wildlife and nature tourism
- Airline industry news
- National park access and regulations
- Wildfire impacts on travel
- Beach and coastal destinations
- Historic preservation and exhibits
- Family travel policies
- Amtrak scenic routes
- International travel warnings
- Hidden gems and underrated parks

## Travel Safety & Advisories

- [U.S. East Coast On Alert After National Hurricane Center Announces Atlantic Disturbance](https://www.thetravel.com/national-hurricane-center-announces-tropical-storm-erin): Tropical Storm Erin may become first Atlantic hurricane of season
- [Air Quality Advisory In The U.S. As Everglades Fire Covers South Florida In Smoke](https://www.thetravel.com/air-quality-advisory-in-effect-everglades-fire-south-florida): Everglades wildfires trigger air quality warnings in Broward County
- [Southern California Wildfire Is Forcing Evacuation Orders For Thousands Only Months After January Blazes](https://www.thetravel.com/canyon-fire-california-la-county-ventura-county-southern-california-wildfire-evacuations): Canyon Fire forces evacuations in LA and Ventura counties
- [US Issues Level 2 Travel Advisory for Thailand Amid Border Conflict](https://www.thetravel.com/us-government-travel-advisory-thailand): State Department raises Thailand warning due to Cambodia border conflict

- [Air Canada Just Leaped In Front Of U.S. Carriers For Top Ranking But Experts Claim They Cheated](https://www.thetravel.com/air-canada-top-ranking-performance): Air Canada tops on-time performance rankings amid expansion criticism
- [Air Canada Applauded By Canadians For Replacing Dipping U.S. Travel With An Unexpected Market](https://www.thetravel.com/air-canada-applauded-by-canadians-for-replacing-dipping-us-travel-with-an-unexpected-market): Air Canada shifts from U.S. routes to Latin America and Atlantic markets

## National Parks & Wildlife

- [California National Park Site Is First To Obey Trump's 'Improper Ideology' Order](https://www.thetravel.com/muir-woods-exhibit-sign-removed-trump-improper-ideology-order): Muir Woods removes exhibit sign following Trump executive order
- ['It's Only Getting Worse': Florida National Park Site Now Only Open Once A Month Thanks To Federal Cuts](https://www.thetravel.com/fort-barrancas-now-only-open-once-a-month-thanks-to-federal-cuts): Fort Barrancas reduces hours to monthly due to federal budget cuts
- [Watch Live: Now Is The Best Time To See Bears In Katmai National Park](https://www.thetravel.com/best-time-to-see-bears-katmai-national-park-watch-live): Brooks Falls live webcam shows bears during Alaska salmon run season
- [Yellowstone National Park Has A Grizzly Bear Problem: Here's How They Are Quietly Handling It](https://www.thetravel.com/yellowstone-national-park-grizzly-bear-problem): Yellowstone relocates grizzly bears amid cattle conflicts and overcrowding
- [Underrated, But Worth Visiting In 2025: Nevada's Most Overlooked National Park](https://www.thetravel.com/grand-basin-national-park-underrated-but-worth-visiting-in-2025): Great Basin National Park features caves, stargazing, and Wheeler Peak
- [This Little-Known Oregon National Park Site Rivals Glacier With Jagged Peaks, Alpine Lakes, And More](https://www.thetravel.com/wallowa-whitman-national-forest-oregon-like-glacier-national-park): Wallowa-Whitman National Forest offers Glacier-like scenery in Oregon
